assessment_methods.method: Written test (theoretical/practical questions, problems, essay) - P1
Written test (theoretical/practical questions, problems, essay) - P2

assessment_rules: For continuous assessment (first opportunity), two partial written tests (P1 and P2) account for 30% each of the final grade, covering theoretical content. A written problem-solving test (E1) accounts for 40% of the grade. The final grade is P1+P2+E1. For the second opportunity (E2), a single written test worth 100% will cover both theoretical content and problem-solving. Students opting out of continuous assessment may take a global written exam (EG) worth 100% on the official exam date, covering all course content in similar proportions. Unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, unauthorized electronic devices) will result in a failing grade of 0.0 for the entire academic year.
